question: What supreme accomplishment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be united as a great accomplishment.
Such great accomplishment belongs to or relates to the yoginīs.
Possessing this accomplishment results in becoming dear to them.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
